امتدحوا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَدَحُوا (imtadaḥū) /im.ta.da.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# اُمْتُدِحُوا (umtudiḥū) /um.tu.di.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# اِمْتَدِحُوا (imtadiḥū) /im.ta.di.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
